label: Post Office

example.title: United States Post Office, 526 Main Street

brief: One-storey 1967 post office in a colonial-revival dress to suit an old river town: red brick with cast-stone quoins, a raised-letter frieze reading UNITED STATES POST OFFICE with the town and ZIP, a central round-arched doorway with a fanlight over paneled double doors, flanked by pairs of tall round-arched multi-pane windows. A later green standing-seam mansard-style roof caps it; carriage lamps, planters and a railed ramp at the side; dedication plaque by the door.
